procedural_matters: The hearing was conducted by a panel under N1.4(b).
facts: At the end of race 2, ITA 223231 sailed to leeward of the Finish Race Committee Vessel and leeward of the blue Finish Pin Marksetbot.
ITA 223231 returned to the course side and sailed between the Finish Race Committee Vessel and the blue Finish Pin Marksetbot.
conclusions: ITA 2233231 corrected her error in sailing the course in accordance with RRS 28.2.
ITA 2233231’s place in race 2 was made significantly worse through her own fault. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 64.1(b) are not met.
